```{r}
properties <- c("log_max_strain",
                "bc_1","bc_2","bc_3","bc_4", "bc_5", "bc_6")
n_prop <- length(properties)
n_dim <- length(metals)
```

### Modify into sets

```{r}
dat_ss_all <- dat_ss_t%>%
                filter(!(alloy %in% metals))%>%
                mutate(type = "t")%>%
                bind_rows(dat_ss_c%>%
                            mutate(type ="c"))%>%
                unite("alloy_id",
                      Mo:W,remove = FALSE)%>%
                arrange(alloy_id, rep, type)#%>%
                  #filter(! alloy %in% metals)

dat_ss_fil <- dat_ss_all%>%
              ungroup()%>%
              group_by(alloy_id)%>%
              arrange(desc(rep))%>%
              slice_head(n=1)
```




### Parameters

```{r}
joint_cov <- het_sv <-joint_ls_gp <- F
max_train_iters <- 10
scale_vars <- "after"
al_steps <- 6
exp_name <- "train_bin_rl_gen_sig_prior_gam_int_m32_2026_05_25"
only_int <- T
ini_seed <- 233545
np_seed <- 12143
verbose <- F
pen_par <- F
prior_th <- "gam"
sig_type <- "general"
n_order <- 3
ini_prev_mod <- T
cov_type = "Matern3_2" #"Gaussian", "Matern5_2", "Matern3_2"


cor_fun_test <- function(theta, D_mat) general_cor_fun(theta = theta,
                                                       D_mat = D_mat,
                                                       kernel_fun = matern_3_2_fun) #matern_5_2_fun gaus_ker_fun
```

```{r}
priors <- construct_prior_fun(n_dim =  length(metals) - 1,
                              prior_type = prior_th)
```

```{r}
dat_ss_fil <- dat_ss_fil%>%
  mutate(elements= (Mo>0) + (Nb>0) + (Ta>0) + (V>0) + (W>0))
  
```

```{r}
  ## Training

set.seed(np_seed)


temp <- dat_ss_fil%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  filter(elements == 2,
         round(pmax(Mo,Nb,Ta,V,W),1) %in% c(0.1,0.3,0.5,0.7,0.9) 
         )%>%
  arrange(alloy_cnt)

#temp <- temp[-which(temp$alloy_cnt == 59),] #59 is the quanary with x =0.2 for all elements


id_train <- temp$alloy_cnt



dat_ss_train <- dat_ss_fil%>%
      filter((alloy_cnt %in% id_train))%>%
  arrange(alloy_cnt)



dat_train <- dat_ss_all%>%
      filter(alloy_cnt %in% id_train)%>%
      arrange(alloy_cnt)%>%
                  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(properties),
                               names_to = "property",
                               values_to = "val_true")

dat_train_B <- dat_train%>%
    group_by(alloy_cnt, rep)%>%
  slice_head(n=1)
    
dat_train_c <- dat_train%>%
      filter(type == "c")
    
dat_train_t <- dat_train%>%
      filter(type == "t")
```

```{r}
max_ac <- max(dat_ss_fil$alloy_cnt)

  bind_rows(dat_ss_ter_t%>%
              mutate(alloy_cnt = alloy_cnt + max_ac))%>%
  arrange(alloy_cnt)

  bind_rows(dat_ss_ter_c%>%

              slice_head(n=1)%>%
```

```{r}
set.seed(ini_seed)
test_pX_bin <- gen.mixture(levels = 3,
                  vars = metals)
    
idp <- which(sapply(1:nrow(test_pX_bin), 
                        function(i) max(test_pX_bin[i,]) == 1 ))
test_pX_bin <- as.matrix(test_pX_bin[-idp,])
    
test_pX <- gen.mixture(levels = 4,
                  vars = metals)
test_pX <- rbind(as.matrix(test_pX),
                     test_pX_bin)
idp <- which(sapply(1:nrow(test_pX), function(i) max(test_pX[i,]) == 1 ))
    
pX_edge <- test_pX[idp,]
pX_edge_ilr <- ilr_bounded_minmax_additive(pX_edge,
                                             epsilon = eps_ilr,
                                             z_min = xx$z_min,
                                             z_max = xx$z_max)$u
    
test_pXB <- rbind(test_pX[-idp,],
                     test_pX[idp,])
test_pX <- test_pX[-idp,]

test_pX_ilr <- ilr_bounded_minmax_additive(test_pX,
                                             epsilon = eps_ilr,
                                             z_min = xx$z_min,
                                             z_max = xx$z_max)$u

test_pXB_ilr <- ilr_bounded_minmax_additive(test_pXB,
                                             epsilon = eps_ilr,
                                             z_min = xx$z_min,
                                             z_max = xx$z_max)$u
    
n_ed <- length(metals)

y_ini_c <- as.vector(dat_train_c$val_true)

    
y_ini_t <- as.vector(dat_train_t$val_true)

    
a_reps <- dat_ss_all%>%
      arrange(alloy_cnt)%>%
      filter((alloy_cnt %in% id_train))%>%
                ungroup()%>%
                group_by(alloy_cnt)%>%
                tally()
    
a_reps <- a_reps$n/2


#homogeneous solution
Y_train_c <- matrix(y_ini_c,
                        ncol = n_prop,
                        byrow = T)
  
      
  Y_train_t <- matrix(y_ini_t,
                          ncol = n_prop,
                          byrow = T)
  
    result_stats_c <- compute_mean_var_fun(Y = Y_train_c,
                                     a_mult = a_reps,
                                     rescale_y = scale_vars)

    ini_hom_c <- ini_pars_hom_fun(result_stats_c, 
                                  n_prop = length(properties),
                                  cov_bp = sig_type,
                                  n_dim = n_dim,
                                  log_bounds = log(c(1e-1,4,10)),
                                  prior_mean = log(priors$ini_ls))
    
    result_stats_t <- compute_mean_var_fun(Y = Y_train_t,

                                  n_dim = n_dim,
                                  n_prop = length(properties),
                                  cov_bp = sig_type,
                                  log_bounds = log(c(1e-1,4,10)),
                                  prior_mean = log(priors$ini_ls))
```

```{r}
    np_id_h <- NULL
    
for(iter in 0:5){
  
  file_name <- paste0(exp_name,"_RLV2_iter_",iter,".RData")
  file_path <- here::here("Results","Fixed Data",file_name)
  
  
  X_train <-X_ini
  X_cand <- X_cand_ini
  X_cand_B <- X_cand_ini_B
  X_train_B <- X_ini_B
  y_train_c <- y_ini_c
  y_train_t <- y_ini_t
  
  if(iter > 0){
    idx <- 1:3 + (np_id_h[1]-1) *3
    idx_b <- 1:(3*n_prop) + (np_id_h[1]-1) *(3*n_prop) 
    
    if(iter > 1){
      for(j in 2:iter){
        idx <- c(idx, 1:3 + (np_id_h[j]-1) *3)
        idx_b <- c(idx_b, 1:(3*n_prop) + (np_id_h[j]-1) *(3*n_prop))
      } 
    }
    
    X_cand <- X_cand_ini[-np_id_h,]
    X_cand_B <- X_cand_ini_B[-idx,]
    
    y_train_c <- c(y_train_c, 
                   dat_ss_c_cand$val_true[idx_b])
    y_train_t <- c(y_train_t, 
                   dat_ss_t_cand$val_true[idx_b])
    a_reps <- c(a_reps, 3)
    X_train <- rbind(X_ini,
                     X_cand_ini[np_id_h,])
    
    X_train_B <- rbind(X_ini_B,
                     X_cand_ini_B[idx,])
    
  }
  Y_train_c <- matrix(y_train_c,
                        ncol = n_prop,
                        byrow = T)
  
      
  Y_train_t <- matrix(y_train_t,
                          ncol = n_prop,
                          byrow = T)
  
  
  Basis_X <- Basis_X_all <- NULL
  
  if(!only_int){
    Basis_X <- create_poly_basis(X_train,
                                   n_out = n_prop,
                                   prop_names = prop_b,
                                   sparse_mat = T,
                               degree = 1,
                               omit_last_var = T,
                                   var_names = metals)

    Basis_X_all <- create_poly_basis(X_train_B,
                                       n_out = n_prop,
                                       prop_names = prop_b,
                                       sparse_mat = T,
                                   degree = 1,
                                   omit_last_var = T,
                                       var_names = metals)
  }

  X_train_ilr <- ilr_bounded_minmax_additive(X_train,
                                             b = 0,
                                             epsilon = eps_ilr,
                                             z_min = xx$z_min,
                                             z_max = xx$z_max)$u
  
  if(file.exists(file_path)){
    load(file_path)
  }else{
    ## Training
    
    #PX
    ini_sol_h <- ini_hom_c$ini
    if(iter>0) ini_hom_c <- update_ini_pars_fun(mod_hom_c$opt_sol$solution,
                                     ini_hom_c)
    message("Homogeneous Compression")
    message(Sys.time())
    mod_hom_c <- fit_mvgp_sv_fun(Y = Y_train_c,
                            X = X_train_ilr,
                            X_pred = Basis_X,
                            X_pred_all = Basis_X_all,
                            a_mult = a_reps,
                            cor_fun = cor_fun_test,
                            cov_bp = sig_type,
                            joint_cov = joint_cov,
                            het_sv = F,
                            lb = ini_hom_c$lb,
                            ub = ini_hom_c$ub,
                            ini_pars = ini_hom_c$ini,
                            joint_ls_gp = joint_ls_gp,
                            max_it =max_train_iters,
                            rescale_y = scale_vars,
                            rs = result_stats_c,
                            verbose = verbose,
                            prior_theta = priors$pf)
    
    eval_log_c <- fit_mvgp_sv_fun(Y = Y_train_c,
                        X = X_train_ilr,
                        X_pred = Basis_X,
                            X_pred_all = Basis_X_all,
                        a_mult = a_reps,
                        cov_bp = sig_type,
                        cor_fun = cor_fun_test,
                        joint_cov = joint_cov,
                        het_sv = F,
                        ini_pars = mod_hom_c$opt_sol$solution,
                        joint_ls_gp = joint_ls_gp,
                        opt = F,
                        rescale_y = scale_vars,
                            verbose = verbose,
                        prior_theta = priors$pf)
    
    
    if(iter>0) ini_hom_t <- update_ini_pars_fun(mod_hom_t$opt_sol$solution,
                                     ini_hom_t)
    message("Homogeneous Tension")
    message(Sys.time())
    
    mod_hom_t <- fit_mvgp_sv_fun(Y = Y_train_t,
                            X = X_train_ilr,
                            X_pred = Basis_X,
                            X_pred_all = Basis_X_all,
                            a_mult = a_reps,
                            cor_fun = cor_fun_test,
                            joint_cov = joint_cov,
                            cov_bp = sig_type,
                            het_sv = F,
                            lb = ini_hom_t$lb,
                            ub = ini_hom_t$ub,
                            ini_pars = ini_hom_t$ini,
                            joint_ls_gp = joint_ls_gp,
                            max_it =max_train_iters,
                            rescale_y = scale_vars,
                            rs = result_stats_t,
                            verbose = verbose,
                            prior_theta = priors$pf)
    
    
    eval_log_t <- fit_mvgp_sv_fun(Y = Y_train_t,
                            X = X_train_ilr,
                            X_pred = Basis_X,
                            X_pred_all = Basis_X_all,
                            a_mult = a_reps,
                            cor_fun = cor_fun_test,
                            cov_bp = sig_type,
                            joint_cov = joint_cov,
                            het_sv = F,
                            ini_pars = mod_hom_t$opt_sol$solution,
                            joint_ls_gp = joint_ls_gp,
                            max_it =max_train_iters,
                            opt = F,
                            rescale_y = scale_vars,
                            verbose = verbose,
                            prior_theta = priors$pf)
    
    ### Heterogeneous solution
    
    message("Heterogeneous Tension")
    message(Sys.time())
  
    pen_par <- F
    am_px <- rep(1,nrow(test_pXB))
    nrPx <- nrow(test_pXB)
    nrt <- nrow(X_train)
    
    idx_1 <- which(duplicated(rbind(test_pXB,X_train)))
    idx_2 <- which(duplicated(rbind(X_train, test_pXB)))
    am_px[idx_2 - nrt] <- a_reps[idx_1 - nrPx]
    
    if(iter >0){
      ini_sol_t <- update_ini_pars_fun(mod_t$opt_sol$solution,
                                 ini_sol = ini_sol_t)
    }else{
      ini_sol_t <- pars_hom_to_het_reg(mod_hom_t$opt_sol$solution,
                               n_properties = n_prop,
                               pX = test_pX_ilr,
                               X = X_train_ilr,
                               cov_bp = sig_type,
                               edge_locs = pX_edge_ilr,
                               var_mat = result_stats_t$var_mat,
                               idx_use = result_stats_t$idx,
                                cor_fun = cor_fun_test,
                                phi_h = attr(eval_log_t,"psi"),
                               log_mult = c(-log(2),log(1.5), log(2)),
                               log_bounds =c(-log(20), log(5),
                                         log(25))
                               )
    }
    
    
    
    mod_t <- fit_mvgp_sv_fun(Y = Y_train_t,
                        X = X_train_ilr,
                        X_pred = Basis_X,
                        X_pred_all = Basis_X_all,
                        a_mult = a_reps,
                        pX = test_pXB_ilr,
                        a_mult_px = am_px,
                        n_edge = n_ed,
                        cor_fun = cor_fun_test,
                        cov_bp = sig_type,
                        joint_cov = joint_cov,
                        het_sv = T,
                        ini_pars = ini_sol_t$ini,
                        ub = ini_sol_t$ub,
                        lb = ini_sol_t$lb,
                        penalty = pen_par,
                        joint_ls_gp = joint_ls_gp,
                        max_it = max_train_iters,
                        rescale_y = scale_vars,
                        #eps = 1e-7,
                        rs = result_stats_t,
                            verbose = verbose,
                        prior_theta = priors$pf)
    
    
    message("Heterogeneous Compression")
    message(Sys.time())
    
    
    if(iter>0){
      ini_sol_c <- update_ini_pars_fun(mod_c$opt_sol$solution,
                                 ini_sol = ini_sol_c)
    }else{
      ini_sol_c <- pars_hom_to_het_reg(mod_hom_c$opt_sol$solution,
                           n_properties = n_prop,
                           pX = test_pX_ilr,
                           X = X_train_ilr,
                           cov_bp = sig_type,
                           edge_locs = pX_edge_ilr,
                           var_mat = result_stats_c$var_mat,
                           idx_use = result_stats_c$idx,
                            cor_fun = cor_fun_test,
                            phi_h = attr(eval_log_c,"psi"),
                           log_mult = c(-log(2),log(1.5), log(2)),
                           log_bounds =c(-log(20),
                                         log(5),
                                         log(25))
                           )
    }
    
    

    mod_c <- fit_mvgp_sv_fun(Y = Y_train_c,
                            X = X_train_ilr,
                            X_pred = Basis_X,
                            X_pred_all = Basis_X_all,
                            a_mult = a_reps,
                            pX = test_pXB_ilr,
                            a_mult_px =am_px,
                            cov_bp = sig_type,
                            n_edge = n_ed,
                            cor_fun = cor_fun_test,
                            joint_cov = joint_cov,
                            het_sv = T,
                            ini_pars = ini_sol_c$ini,
                            ub = ini_sol_c$ub,
                            lb = ini_sol_c$lb,
                            penalty = pen_par,
                            joint_ls_gp = F,
                            #eps = 1e-7,
                            max_it = max_train_iters,
                            rescale_y = scale_vars,
                            rs = result_stats_c,
                            verbose = verbose,
                            prior_theta = priors$pf)
    
    ## Prediction object
    message("Predictive Objects")
    message(Sys.time())
    
    test_pred_obj_t <- construct_pred_obj_fun(pars = mod_t$opt_sol$solution,
                                        X = X_train_ilr,
                                        Y_mat = mod_t$Y,
                                        y_bar = mod_t$y_bar,
                                        X_pred = Basis_X,
                                        X_pred_all = Basis_X_all,
                                        pX = test_pXB_ilr,
                                        n_edge = n_ed,
                                        n_properties = n_prop,
                                        a_mult = a_reps,
                                        a_mult_pX = am_px,
                                        #eps = 1e-7,
                                        cor_fun_gp = cor_fun_test,
                                        cov_type = cov_type,
                                        cov_bp = sig_type,
                                        rescale_y = mod_t$rs_y,
                                        rs_mean = mod_t$rs_mean,
                                        rs_mult = mod_t$rs_mult)

    test_pred_obj_c <- construct_pred_obj_fun(pars = mod_c$opt_sol$solution,
                                            X = X_train_ilr,
                                            X_pred = Basis_X,
                                            X_pred_all = Basis_X_all,
                                            Y_mat = mod_c$Y,
                                            y_bar = mod_c$y_bar,
                                            pX = test_pXB_ilr,
                                            n_edge = n_ed,
                                            n_properties = n_prop,
                                            a_mult = a_reps,
                                            a_mult_pX = am_px,
                                            #eps = 1e-7,
                                            cor_fun_gp = cor_fun_test,
                                            cov_type = cov_type,
                                            cov_bp = sig_type,
                                            rescale_y = mod_c$rs_y,
                                            rs_mean = mod_c$rs_mean,
                                            rs_mult = mod_c$rs_mult)
    
    test_pred_obj_hom_c <- construct_pred_hom_obj_fun(pars = mod_hom_c$opt_sol$solution,
                                                      X= X_train_ilr,
                                                      Y_mat = mod_hom_c$Y,
                                                      y_bar = mod_hom_c$y_bar,
                                                      X_pred = Basis_X,
                                                      X_pred_all = Basis_X_all,
                                                      n_properties = n_prop,
                                                      a_mult = a_reps,
                                                      cor_fun_gp = cor_fun_test,
                                                      cov_type = cov_type,
                                                      cov_bp = sig_type,
                                                      rescale_y = mod_hom_c$rs_y,
                                                      rs_mean = mod_hom_c$rs_mean,
                                                      rs_mult = mod_hom_c$rs_mult)
    
    test_pred_obj_hom_t <- construct_pred_hom_obj_fun(pars = mod_hom_t$opt_sol$solution,
                                                      X= X_train_ilr,
                                                      Y_mat = mod_hom_t$Y,
                                                      y_bar = mod_hom_t$y_bar,
                                                      X_pred = Basis_X,
                                                      X_pred_all = Basis_X_all,
                                                      n_properties = n_prop,
                                                      a_mult = a_reps,
                                                      cor_fun_gp = cor_fun_test,
                                                      cov_type = cov_type,
                                                      cov_bp = sig_type,
                                                      rescale_y = mod_hom_t$rs_y,
                                                      rs_mean = mod_hom_t$rs_mean,
                                                      rs_mult = mod_hom_t$rs_mult)
    
    
    pol<- list("Tension" = test_pred_obj_t,
               "Compression" = test_pred_obj_c)
    
    X_cand_ilr <- ilr_bounded_minmax_additive(as.matrix(X_cand[,metals]),
                                             epsilon = eps_ilr,
                                             z_min = xx$z_min,
                                             z_max = xx$z_max)$u
    
    next_point <- IMSPE_MV_batch_search(pred_obj = pol,
                                        Xcand = X_cand_ilr,
                                        seed = np_seed,
                                        n_reps_batch = 3,
                                        n_block = 2,
                                        cv = F,
                                        n_cores = 3)
    
    pol[["Tension-Hom"]] = test_pred_obj_hom_t
    pol[["Compression-Hom"]]  = test_pred_obj_hom_c
    
    message(paste("Com-Het th:", paste(exp(test_pred_obj_c$theta),
                                       collapse = ", ")))
    message(paste("Com-Hom th:", paste(exp(test_pred_obj_hom_c$theta), 
                                       collapse = ", ")))
    message(paste("Ten-Het th:", paste(exp(test_pred_obj_t$theta), 
                                       collapse = ", ")))
    message(paste("Ten-Hom th:", paste(exp(test_pred_obj_hom_t$theta), 
                                       collapse = ", ")))
    
    save(result_stats_c,result_stats_t,
      ini_sol_c,ini_sol_t,
     mod_c,mod_hom_c,
     mod_hom_t,mod_t,
     pol,
     next_point,
     file = file_path)
  }
  
  np_id_h <- c(np_id_h, 
               which.min(rdist::cdist(next_point$best_obj$par,X_cand_ini_ilr)))
  
  save(np_id_h,
     file = here::here("Results","Fixed Data",
                       "ALV2_26_prior_gam_np_h_gen_sig_int_m32.RData"))
  
}
```
